question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is-** 'option 2)'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• in the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is -**'Arachic'**.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is -**'Archaic'**.
 
• The word 'Archaic' is used to mean- very old fashioned. 
 
• Example - *The walls are frequently covered in very basic, red and black **archaic**__ artwork.​*
 
• Thus, ***option 2)*** is the correct option.

*​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information __**** *Let us understand the meaning of other options.

__
 
• Bombastic- **High-sounding**, **pompous, showy**

 
 
• Example- He soon found that making a*** bombastic**__* movie was something he never thought of.
 
 
 
• Benign- **Kind or gentle.**
 __
 
• Example- There was a ***benign***__ smile on her face when she came to greet us.
 
 
 
• Artless- **simple, lacking art.**
 __
 
• Example- Her uncomplicated, ***artless ***__appeal immediately charmed us over.
